sermon.title: What Happens After You Die?
sermon.speaker: Pastor David G. Kincer
sermon.summary: In this short message, Pastor David G. Kincer says that when you die your body decays, your spirit leaves your body, and you immediately stand before Jesus Christ to be judged for what you did in this body. He tells of visions of hell and the judgment day and says ministers should persuade people to turn, because Christ died so they would not have to burn.
sermon.transcript_source: This transcript comes from YouTube’s automatic English captions, which supply the timing and the words. Punctuation, capitalization and paragraphing were added from the speaker’s pauses and then corrected by hand, and obvious caption errors (names, Bible references) were fixed; his wording was not rewritten. “[unclear]” marks a word or name that was not clear. Editor notes: The visions of hell and the judgment he describes are his own testimony as spoken.

chunks.section_question: What happens to your body after you die?
chunks.short_answer: He says just a few minutes after you die your body starts decaying; if you are not buried, maggots and bacteria begin to eat it, and if you are buried, worms and insects do. He says all the beautiful stuff we spend so much time on suddenly is not so beautiful anymore, so we must be buried or burned.

Maggots will begin to eat your body and [unclear] will begin to eat it the bacteria in your body will begin to eat your body if you’re buried the worms and the insects and critters in the ground will begin to eat your body. And uh. All this beautiful stuff that we spend so much time on suddenly isn’t so beautiful anymore. Or we can be burned we either got to be buried or we got to be burned because we start stinking.

From James 2:26 he says people say you are dead when your heart or brain waves stop, but God says you are dead when he takes the spirit out of your body.
chunks.text: And so immediately this physical body that you have worshiped all your life and did everything to clothe it with the latest clothing and the latest hair fashion and all the rest just starts. Rotting away the bacteria inside your body just takes over the first thing that happens when you die is your spirit leaves your body. James chapter 2 verse 26. As the body without the spirit is dead you see they say when your heart stops beating you’re dead they say when your brain waves stop waving you’re dead. But God says when my spirit when I take that spirit out of your body you’re dead and as we’ve seen in the Bible those were resurrected because he put the spirit back in them.

chunks.section_question: Why should preachers try to persuade people about the judgment?
chunks.short_answer: He says we receive the things done in this body, whether good or bad, and “knowing therefore the terror of the Lord we persuade men” should be every minister’s real motivation. He tells how, as a young Christian, God showed him the sin in homes he passed and he would weep, because those people would be held accountable and somebody needed to tell them.
chunks.text:
Appear before the judgment seat of Christ to receive the things done. By our faith. In our faith. In our grace. No done what in this body how you lived. While you were in this body. Whether you did good or whether you did bad. Knowing therefore the terror of the Lord we persuade men what should be the real motivation of every minister preaching the gospel. To persuade people to avoid the judgment of Jesus Christ. I can remember as a young Christian driving down the freeway and God would just open my eyes to the sin going on in the homes that I was passing by now I didn’t have x-ray vision and actually see what was happening but he just said this is what’s you know he just showed me and I would just weep.

Because these people were doing things that they were going to be held accountable to God for and somebody needed to tell them. See this is the basic message of the gospel. Didn’t he say it’s a terror doesn’t he say it’s a fearful thing yeah. You think you’re not wanting to hear the bad news of the gospel that it’s going to change the gospel.

chunks.section_question: What did he see of hell and judgment day?
chunks.short_answer: He says once, between two jobs, his eyes were opened to see hell and the judgment day, where people stood before Christ and no one said a word because they knew they were wrong. He says hell is not a pleasant place, and those who say they will have friends there are fools, because isolation is one of the parts of hell.
chunks.text: Again I was working two jobs and I come home in between jobs I had just enough time to eat and I was sitting there and suddenly my eyes were open to see hell and it wasn’t pleasant. And then my eyes were open to that judgment day and people were standing before Christ and no one was saying a word because they knew they knew they were wrong when they did the wrong. There was no debates there. And it was a horrible thing to be in hell and people that say well I’m going to go hell that’s where my sons and daughters are my best friend you are a fool yeah hell is not a pleasant place and if you think you’re going to have friends down there forget it. Isolation is one of the parts of hell.

No church, book, minister or the pope can save you in that day; you will be judged by what you did in this body, and from Romans 14:10 everyone shall give account of himself to God.

He says the light from the throne exposed everything impure with no arguments, and from Matthew 12:36-37 that men will give account of every idle word, and by your words you will be justified or condemned.

faqs.question: When is a person really dead, according to the Bible?
faqs.answer: He says people say you are dead when your heart stops or your brain waves stop, but God says you are dead when he takes the spirit out of your body; those resurrected in the Bible came back when he put the spirit back in them.

scriptures.text_nkjv: For as the body without the spirit is dead, so faith without works is dead also.

faqs.question: Will science catch up with the Bible on death?
faqs.answer: He says one day science is going to catch up with the Bible, since they already have a hard time figuring out why some people dead several days came back to life with nothing wrong.

faqs.question: Could anyone kill Jesus?
faqs.answer: He says no man could kill Jesus because he was God; he had to give up his life himself, and he gave up the spirit and the body died.

scriptures.text_nkjv: And when Jesus had cried out with a loud voice, He said, “Father, ‘into Your hands I commit My spirit.’ ” Having said this, He breathed His last.

faqs.question: Will believers also stand before the judgment seat of Christ?
faqs.answer: He says “we must all” appear before the judgment seat of Christ and that includes believers, to receive the things done not by our faith or grace but in this body, whether good or bad.

scriptures.text_nkjv: For we must all appear before the judgment seat of Christ, that each one may receive the things done in the body, according to what he has done, whether good or bad.

faqs.question: Is it wrong to preach a “scary” gospel?
faqs.answer: He says reading in the Bible about standing before God should scare you into eternal life, and asks “doesn’t he say it’s a fearful thing.”

scriptures.text_nkjv: It is a fearful thing to fall into the hands of the living God.

faqs.question: Will you have friends in hell?
faqs.answer: He says if you think you are going to have friends down there, forget it; isolation is one of the parts of hell.

faqs.question: Why did Christ die on the cross?
faqs.answer: He says Christ died on the cross so you would not have to burn; that is the good part of the gospel, and the bad part is that if you do not turn you will burn.

faqs.question: Will people argue with God at the judgment?
faqs.answer: He says in what he saw there were no debates and no arguments; the light from the throne exposed every impure thing and they knew they were wrong when they did it.
